description: One window a scheduler may place work in — "Monday 09:00–12:00, 60 units" — with the capacity it offers and the load the host has already committed to it. The record is a VALUE: the host recomposes it with window with { … }. Capacity is the amount of work the window accepts and Used the amount already taken by work the board does not show (other schedules, reservations, the host's own backlog), so a window can be FULL or even OVERLOADED before the board places anything in it. Both are reported as words plus an icon, never as a colour alone. Nothing is invented: a window whose End is not after its Start offers no time at all (the planner skips it, and the surface never divides by its length), a negative Capacity reads as zero and a negative Used as zero. A blank Id is REJECTED at construction, because the run segments and the reader's own placement are keyed by it.

members.name: Contains
members.description: Whether instant falls inside the window. The end is EXCLUSIVE: a run starting exactly when a window closes belongs to the next one, which is what makes two adjacent windows partition the timeline rather than overlap by an instant.

members.name: Available
members.description: The units still free for the board, never negative (an overloaded window offers nothing).

members.name: Capacity
members.description: How much work the window accepts. A negative value reads as zero through EffectiveCapacity.

members.name: Day
members.description: The day the window belongs to, in its own offset. A window that starts at 22:00 belongs to the day it starts on; a window that starts before midnight and ends after it is still that day's window.

members.name: Duration
members.description: How long the window offers, or Zero when it closes before it opens.

members.name: EffectiveCapacity
members.description: The capacity the planner actually uses: the host's value, never below zero.

members.name: EffectiveUsed
members.description: The committed load the planner actually uses: the host's value, never below zero.

members.name: HasDuration
members.description: Whether the window offers any time at all.

members.name: Id
members.description: Stable identity of the window. Never empty: construction rejects a blank value.

members.name: IsFull
members.description: Whether the host's committed work already fills the window exactly (or beyond).

members.name: IsOverloaded
members.description: Whether the host has committed more work than the window accepts.

members.name: Overflow
members.description: How many units the window is over its capacity by (zero when it is not overloaded).

members.name: Used
members.description: How much capacity the host has already committed to work this surface does not show.

members.name: Utilization
members.description: The share of the capacity that is already committed, in 0…1 (0 for a window with no capacity).
